svg.text: The postpay audit: today and with PI Agent
Payer staff, step changed by PI Agent
People do every hand-off; the chart review and sign-offs carry most of the cost.
Software screens, requests, reads and estimates; people approve the list and sign the demand.
Chooses whom to ask and how many
Reads each chart by rule; a
only if it covers its cost
A simplification: not every path is drawn. PI Agent is simulated on synthetic claims.
